				<div class="has_eae_slider elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-39cbd20b" data-eae-slider="58186" data-id="39cbd20b" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-361d8ada elementor-widget elementor-widget-spacer" data-id="361d8ada" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="spacer.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">

		</div>

						<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
					<div class="has_eae_slider elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-c48214f" data-eae-slider="35583" data-id="c48214f" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-79114331 elementor-widget elementor-widget-image" data-id="79114331" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="image.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
															<img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="800" height="480" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20480'%3E%3C/svg%3E" class="attachment-large size-large wp-image-6277" alt="Kitespot Playa de El Médano, Tenerife" data-lazy-srcset="https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-1024x614.jpg 1024w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-300x180.jpg 300w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-768x461.jpg 768w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-18x12.jpg 18w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04.jpg 1200w" data-lazy-sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px" data-lazy-src="https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-1024x614.jpg" /><noscript><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="800" height="480" src="https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-1024x614.jpg" class="attachment-large size-large wp-image-6277" alt="Kitespot Playa de El Médano, Tenerife" srcset="https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-1024x614.jpg 1024w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-300x180.jpg 300w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-768x461.jpg 768w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04-18x12.jpg 18w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_04.jpg 1200w" sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px" /></noscript>															</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-261df5b5 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="261df5b5" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">KITESPOT</h4>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5cfec162 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="5cfec162" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p><strong>Different conditions and a pleasant atmosphere</strong></p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6accfb2 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="6accfb2" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<div class="elementor-divider">
			<span class="elementor-divider-separator">
						</span>
		</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-45c15117 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="45c15117" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>El Médano on Tenerife offers three bays with a variety of kitesurfing spots. From flat water to small ramps and powerful waves, there is something for every kitesurfer.<br /><br />Beginners will find ideal conditions in the northern part of the bay of &#8220;Playa de El Médano&#8221; with a gently sloping sandy beach. In the centre of the bay, there are small ramps for experienced kitesurfers and plenty of space for freestyle tricks.<br /><br />Wave lovers will get their money&#8217;s worth in the neighbouring bay to the east, &#8220;Playa del Cabezo&#8221;, as well as at the spot between the bays. Here, side shore winds and long, clean waves provide the basis for spectacular jumps and wave rides.<br /><br />If it gets too crowded at Playa de El Médano, the &#8220;Playa de la Tejita&#8221; to the west of El Médano offers an alternative with a long sandy beach and a shallow water spot.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>
				<div class="has_eae_slider elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-5601ebf1" data-eae-slider="53236" data-id="5601ebf1" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f9e42cf elementor-widget elementor-widget-image" data-id="f9e42cf" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="image.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
															<img decoding="async" width="800" height="480" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20480'%3E%3C/svg%3E" class="attachment-large size-large wp-image-6280" alt="Kitesurfing in El Médano, Tenerife" data-lazy-srcset="https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-1024x614.jpg 1024w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-300x180.jpg 300w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-768x461.jpg 768w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-18x12.jpg 18w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07.jpg 1200w" data-lazy-sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px" data-lazy-src="https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-1024x614.jpg" /><noscript><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="480" src="https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-1024x614.jpg" class="attachment-large size-large wp-image-6280" alt="Kitesurfing in El Médano, Tenerife" srcset="https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-1024x614.jpg 1024w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-300x180.jpg 300w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-768x461.jpg 768w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07-18x12.jpg 18w, https://tenerife-surfcamp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/tenerife_kite_spot_07.jpg 1200w" sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px" /></noscript>															</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-260194d elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="260194d" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">WIND</h4>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-49ef6fcf elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="49ef6fcf" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p><strong>Constant wind all year round</strong></p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-dd9b1fa elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="dd9b1fa" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<div class="elementor-divider">
			<span class="elementor-divider-separator">
						</span>
		</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-541a914 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="541a914" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>A constant wind blows all year round on the south coast of Tenerife, so you can kitesurf in El Médano all year round.<br /><br />However, the wind is at its best from May to October, when the north-east trade wind provides constant air movement accelerating again on the south side of Tenerife. The midsummer months of June to August then kick it up a notch, with strong winds of over 6 Beaufort almost every day.<br /><br />On a typical trade wind day, the wind blows diagonally side shore from the left towards the spots of El Médano. The wind usually picks up from 11 am until the afternoon. This means that beginners usually have good conditions in the mornings for learning to kitesurf, while the more experienced kitesurfers among you have their turn in the afternoon.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>
					</div>
